Times of Israel live blog, Sunday 25 October 2026 (times are Israel local time; Israel clocks also went back to UTC+2 on 25 Oct). Direct curl 403'd; text retrieved via WebFetch rendering of the page.

9:50 AM — Yashar calls on election committee, AG to stop Netanyahu's meeting with police chief on election integrity
The Yashar party is demanding the Central Election Committee and attorney general cancel a meeting between Prime Minister Netanyahu and Police Commissioner Danny Levy regarding election integrity. An attorney for Yashar stated: "The prime minister heads one of the party lists [in the elections], is not responsible for election integrity" and noted no such meeting occurred before previous elections. The party alleges this meeting aims to "create a false public perception of flaws in the integrity of the elections, without any basis."

9:41 AM — 2 days before election, Democrats say Shin Bet will protect Golan; Winter reportedly also to receive security
The Shin Bet will provide state-funded security protection to Democrats chairman Yair Golan starting immediately, two days before the election. The party announced: "The Shin Bet has informed the office of Democrats chairman...that...his security will be provided under the responsibility of the Shin Bet and funded by the state." Ofer Winter of People of Israel will also reportedly receive protection.

8:46 AM — Manhunt underway after weapon snatched from Givat Shmuel school security guard — police

8:44 AM — Police chief summoned for meeting with Netanyahu, Ben Gvir to discuss electoral integrity – reports
Police Commissioner Daniel Levy is expected to meet with Prime Minister Netanyahu and National Security Minister Itamar Ben Gvir regarding police preparations to secure election integrity. No opposition representatives or Central Elections Committee officials were invited.

8:35 AM — Tehran targeted Iranian Kurdish base in Iraq with drones, Iranian media reports
Iran's Revolutionary Guards targeted the headquarters of the Komala group in Iraq's Kurdistan region using drones, according to Mehr news agency. The statement indicated: "the headquarters of the terrorist and separatist group Komala...was targeted last night."

7:34 AM — 2 Iranian officials confirm Tehran preparing to target US diplomats, personnel — NYT
Two senior Iranian officials confirmed to The New York Times that Tehran is preparing to target US diplomats and personnel. The unnamed officials, including an IRGC member, stated the targeting of American officials was considered "fair game" given Iranian officials killed by the US and Israel. A US official reported evidence of Iranian operatives in the US who are "not just simply Iranian nationals."

6:11 AM — IDF launches pre-planned drill simulating multifront attack, 2 days before election
The IDF began a multifront attack simulation exercise with Israeli Air Force, Northern and Central Commands participating. The IDF stated the drill aims to "maintain the forces' alertness and readiness, strengthen the ability to defend communities." The exercise lasts through tomorrow and was pre-planned with no security concerns expected.

5:47 AM — Saudi-led coalition says it downed Houthi missile launched toward Riyadh
The Saudi-led coalition posted: "Air defenses intercepted and destroyed a ballistic missile launched by the terrorist Houthi militia toward Riyadh."

2:33 AM — Reports: Hamas explicitly threatens Israel with another Oct. 7-style attack
Hamas delivered an unusually direct threat that it is prepared to conduct another October 7-style attack, according to Hebrew media. Senior Hamas members conveyed the message to UN coordinator Ramiz Alakbarov during a Gaza meeting. The coordinator's report stated: "Senior group members claimed that IDF activity in the Gaza Strip...are leading Hamas to lose control in the field...they threatened that...Hamas is ready to again carry out an attack such as the October 7 attack."
